'''Brian Rippetoe''' finished 5th–8th at the [[2002 World Championship]].<ref name="tfn">[https://www.theforce.net/ccg/story/World_Championship_Results_announced_64778.asp World Championship Results announced], theforce.net (3 November 2002)</ref> He won the Yavin IV Regional Championship that sent him to the [[2000 Decipher World Championship]].<ref name="trando-2000">[https://web.archive.org/web/20011027164817fw_/http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com/worlds00.htm World Championships 2000 / Countdown to DecipherCon], Trandosite (Wayback, 27 October 2001)</ref> At DecipherCon 1999 Brian also played [[Young Jedi]]: finished 5 in YJ Opposites.<ref name="dc99yj20_5">[http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/scores/YJ20_5.html DecipherCon 1999 – Event Scores: YJ Opposites], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010108191900/http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/scores/YJ20_5.html Internet Archive]</ref>
